scope: 17 queued market input/context/closed-regime/entry transitions; full B09 W1 row traceability normalization from 16 source review files, CP308 parts, canonical row crosswalk and prior ledger. Not all Bridge transitions or W2 acceptance.

w1.method: Read actual review rows, verify file blob and category counts, normalize span/group/disposition and compare recorded prior row to canonical mapping; independently compare union to exact CP308 category IDs and ledger prior IDs. Overlap links are traceability only.

rows.review: Stage captures previous published map and fresh current map. Key exact direction, absolute offset and excluded end, boundary candle timestamp, visible start and min(end,boundary-1), both initial flags. Read previous only when absolute exclusive end<=first_dirty_main; None miss recalculates. No current-map lookup on repeated same-stage key. Yield then publish current only on successful exit.
rows.handoff: Only reuse independent closed prefixes, not open trading stages. Outer protected append discards retained views on failure. Cached local payload is copied before publication/index projection and T/F.

rows.review: ContextVar token restored in finally. Details merged after status/label; explicit nonnull duration overwrites durationMs after rounding. Sink non-null called directly, else compact flushed stderr. Timed stage starts clock and emits started before try; finally accumulates unrounded milliseconds then completed, even when work fails; finally exception can replace original failure/result.
rows.handoff: Telemetry has no intended price effect, but no blanket exception suppression. Callback errors remain observable.

rows.review: Epoch cache miss converts via Tehran then strips tzinfo. Reverse conversion attaches/replaces tzinfo, not timezone conversion; int truncates toward zero. Native datetime including subclass bypasses display string cache, otherwise exact format parsed; nonnull hits reused (0 epoch valid). No fallback.
rows.handoff: Native chronology uses wall-clock values; serialized epoch is distinct coordinate. Cache lifecycle TB97 scope.

rows.review: Optional tails are retained by reference even main tail if lower_only. Iterate supplied order, int time then Decimal callback O,H,L,C. Consecutive equal key preserves O, max/min previous-first (equal representation retained), latest C. Main floor division except TF1; lower_only bypasses main update entirely. No global merge of discontiguous equal keys, sorting, filling or validation.
rows.handoff: Batch aggregation differs from live checked iterator; same-time lower grouping not equal to RAW timeframe expansion.

rows.review: Fresh typed value cache per invocation. Lookup only inside KeyError catch, on miss as_decimal and store. Same-type equal Decimal can return first representation despite different exponent; existing Decimal returned unchanged by provider on miss. No newly introduced float conversion.
rows.handoff: Exact native representation contract, not universal preservation of every distinct input lexeme. Unhashable/malformed values propagate.

rows.review: Frozen slotted delta holds dirty and settled counts; exact int timeframe (not bool/subclass) positive. Main aliases same lower list at TF1, otherwise separate. Last timestamp null, typed persistent prices empty; append enters stage and returns yielded delta after context exit.
rows.handoff: Bucket owner is input normalization; not behavior ownership.

rows.review: Initial dirty indices lengths; empty yields delta without modification. First timestamp int-converted before validation; rewind lower on previous last exact equality and existing bucket, copy tail; rewind main on aligned last key only nonshared, copy tail. TF1 dirty main=dirty lower. Private price additions and previous-time capture begin before checked iteration.
rows.handoff: Time check occurs during later lazy checked rows; preliminary int conversion can fail outside rollback. Caller input order not repaired.

rows.review: Snapshot old suffixes, prior timestamp; publish new prices then lower/main suffix then last time BEFORE try. Catch BaseException in delta construction or consumer body: restore lower then nonshared main then last time, delete new keys, rethrow. Earlier commit assignments outside try; empty branch outside rollback. Delta counts exclusive max(0,len-1).
rows.handoff: Only bucket transaction rollback, not arbitrary callbacks or view index mutations. Last bucket provisional even with RAW gaps.

rows.review: Enumerate supplied normalized buckets from start_index, convert epoch to Tehran naive and format six components; engine callback classifies original open/close; construct Candle with original OHLC references, order and positional indices. No independent normalization.
rows.handoff: Dynamic Candle/classifier owner conditional; native classifier semantics not inferred for arbitrary configured engine.

rows.review: Fresh view lists/index null and closed cache. Rebuild dirty suffix or zero if no index, replace list before index update. New index with retain_crossings=True if absent or length>capacity; equal capacity refresh. Native refresh guard requires 0<=first<=old_length<=new_length<=size; clear prior history only first<old_length-1; no local rollback. Lower update assigned before separate main; TF1 aliases list/index.
rows.handoff: Retained view may be partially mutated on failure, outer Live owner discards it. Dirty frontier and stable prefix are caller premise, not runtime equivalence.

rows.review: Frozen slotted EngineBundle and MarketContext are reference containers: required engine entries incl nullable E/lifecycle, primary default null; context full lower/main lists and chronology/index, visible bounds, offset zero, trend flags false. Freeze does not recursively freeze lists/index.
rows.handoff: No source selection or behavior acceptance inside record declarations; dynamically supplied module interfaces conditional.

rows.review: Required engine path aliases Reaction/Blue/A/S, data, timeframe/from/to and direction enumerated. E/lifecycle optional; four enabled/disabled flags default enabled, bridge-output store_true, raw timeframe default1. Parse native int then analysis TF guard before RAW TF guard. No independent from/to order or timestamp positivity.
rows.handoff: CLI options do not prove all engines enabled; load and stage gates are distinct (TB67,TB71/73).

rows.review: Timed full read then remove exactly one BOM prefix; JSON parse_float Decimal and default ints. No filter before normalization; parse/read failure propagate, telemetry finally observable.
rows.handoff: Source-only review; no file payload loaded. Decimal lexeme preservation at parse distinct from typed cache equality.

rows.review: Timed pass-through of same source_rows object; reject falsy, normalize full history with lower_only exactly TF1, delegate context construction. No requested window filtering, sorting or future-row truncation.
rows.handoff: Range is presentation, full chronology may resolve provisional earlier behavior with later rows; independent reversal slicing is separate.

rows.review: Use lower buckets at TF1 else main; align from/to floor except TF1. Start lower_bound(start key), inclusive end lower_bound(end key+TF)-1. Reject start>=main len or end<start before clamp to last main. Return context full arrays/index and local display bounds, defaults offset/trends.
rows.handoff: No calculation slicing, no raw_timeframe slots; selected range not necessarily exact requested timestamp endpoints.

rows.review: Mutable slotted PipelineState retains directional results, reusable flag, initial geometry, internal IDs, full E/StopAll/S/candidates and detector/Blue/A maps, invalid A/S IDs, optional primary/live. FullDirectionState holds initial S separately, default fresh StopAll list. No deep copies on construction.
rows.handoff: Accepted vs candidate distinction supplied by orchestration; presence in container not proof of calculation validity or display.

rows.review: Clear three caches before fetching optional clear_market_indexes; nonnull callback invoked before try. Finally invoke same callback then clear time caches. Setup exception bypasses try; callback failure in finally can prevent later time clears. RAW live entry forwards rows and fresh preparer to common runner.
rows.handoff: Native runner calls prepare_pipeline_state without live trading-stage continuation, closed regime resolver separate. No runtime guarantee.

additional_source_anchors.contract: Existing Decimal returned unchanged, other input converted with Decimal(str(value)). Typed equality cache is Bridge-owned.
Index constructor retains source, capacity powers of two, earliest equal extrema. Refresh requires nonshrinking range, clears history on earlier-than-tail dirty, updates times/leaves/parents.
Checked live row iterator numerical int equality, positive, nondecreasing. Persistent prices before private cache additions; pre-yield validation.
Batch versus retained view context construction; prepared index registration and chronology owner.
Closed regime resolver conditional; native active full-stage preparation passes no live stage argument.

findings.detail: Active detailed RAW/Live/Bridge clauses already preserve actual cache equality, transaction scope and chronology. CP341 clarifies historical row linkage and failure/conditional handoffs without rewriting source.
W1 normalized index is traceability, not fresh semantic review of every W1 operation. Access/effect/exit categories retained in original evidence, not counted here.
28 Bridge and 2 Live queue records and 3 accessors remain; semantic F05, R01/R02 remain open.
